book.name: 1 YOHANES
book.title: Nyovara Wao Manasyin Yohanes Po Ratoe 1 YOHANES

content: Wamare wamo Amisye aen, weamo wambeta Apa ayao rai

Sya arikainyo inanuga no wasai, anakotare so syo ratoe more irati wasai indamu vemo wapo ayao kakai rave inya. Weramu ranivara wamo ayao kakai inta rave, Vatane inta be marimbe payao wansai no Injayo Amisye amune rai. Opirati Yesus Kristus taunep, Opamo mamai dave.

Wepi po anasine raunande kakai indamu Po wama ayao kakai ranawan ti mpaya wansai, wirati Po wansaugav wamakare Amisye ai. Po waboma ayao kakai ranawane jewen, yara vatan tenambe mine so awa ayao kakai ma Po ranawan tenambe.
Ranivara wambeta irati Amisye apa ananyao Po wansatuti dai rai, wea umba wandaen wamo Amisye aen to ije.
Are pirati payao pare, “Risyo Amisye aen ivae,” weramu beto Amisye apa ananyaowe raije ramu, vatano napije aruriat akoe pije muno ayao tugae meweno ai.
Yara vatano beto Amisye apa ayao rai, vatano napije muinyo Amisye ai ma mamai to. Ranivara wamare wandaen wambe intabove Amisye ai, weamo wamo raen no taiso:
Vatano rui pirati po raura pare opamo be intabove Amisye ai, syare apa ana dave mo Yesus apa ramaisy.
Amisye apa ananyao wanyine raugaje wansai

Sya arakovo inanuga no wasai, ayao ridatoe ore somamo syo wasatutiro ananyao wanyine inta rai jakato ma jewena. Yara wusyino idaura wasai yarawe wapanave Yesus Kristus ai kobeyoe ti no wasai to, wemirati idaura rijati akato. Ananyao wusyin wasatuti dai umaso mamo Amisye apa ayao wapo ranaun to mi vae.

Weramu ananyao raura so omamo nggwanyin tavone ma. Ananyaowe somamo Kristus beto rai muno weapamo wabeta rai tavon. Weye kaumure, omi raurata irati ayao kakaije rai, merere nto raumandi. Yara vare, omi raurata irati ayao kove rai, omamo nsaneka tutir.
Are pirati po raura pare opamo no vare rai weramu anuga mamuno apa arakova ai, vatano napije pamo kaumure ta no tawan no ai mansanana unumeso.
Are pirati muinyo apa arakova ai, opamo no tawan kobe vare ama uga rai. Taune anuga ngkakavin, weti po vatano kaijinta maugavo ayao kakai raron oma jewena.

Yara are pirati anuga mamuno apa arakova ai, opamo no no kaumure ama uga rai. Muno panya kaumure ama uga bo rai, weti peratori mamaundi muno po apa unanui raito raene jewen. Maisyare omai ti, apa ana dave ma mamaisye ramu.

content.text: Syo ayaowe so ratoe more irati arikainyo inanuga no wasai,
weye Kristus kakaijo wasai ti Amisye po wapa ayao kakai rapaya wasai.
Syo ayaowe so ratoe more irati ajae wasai,
wepirati arono munije so ama manasyinoe no to.
Syo ayaowe so ratoe more irati vatano kamurame wasai,
weye wapo Anakakai Akoe apinde to.
Syo ayaowe so ratoe more arikainyo inanuga no wasai,
weye weapo Injayo Amisye aen to.
Syo ayaowe so ratoe ajae wasai,
wepirati arono munije so ama manasyinoe no to.
Syo ayaowe so ratoe more vatano kamurame wasai,
weye weabambunin muno Ayao Amisye ntuna wasanuga rai muno wapo Anakakai Akoe apinde to.

content: Vemo wasanuga ntento mine so rai jinya muno ama anakotaro ntuna no ama uga rai, rai jinya. Weye wasanuga ntento ana mine so rai, weamo muinyo Injayo Amisye ai ma meweno wasanuga rai.

Mine so ama bekere maisyare so: wama bekero ngkakainoanive, wansanuga ntento ananugo wamo raeno wansamije raije rai, muno wansararino taune wama vambunine muno wama ananugo manui rai--anakotar tenambe umaso mamo Injayo Amisye apa ma jewen, yara mine so ama ma.
Mine so indati raumandi, muno ama anakotaro ntuna ama uga rai, wemirati wansanuga ntento rai, raumandi tavon. Yara vatano utavondi Amisye apa bekere rai, ukova nuge nuganui.
Yesus Kristus apa Marova Akoe

Sya arikainyo inanuga no wasai, munije so ama akari mararai mangkepan to. Wapo ranaun Yesus Kristus apa Marova Akoe indati de wusyimbe. Tugae, soamo vatano wanui inta wuje umarovave Kristus ai. Maisyare omai ti, munije so ama akari mangkepane mamo wandaendije.

Arono wusyinoe vatano umarovave Kristus aije umaso utantuna wansatavon no anugano Amisye rai, weramu wuje wansaora weye wanave tugaive jewena. Weramu ranivara wanave tugaive weratire ma, soamo nanawe wana tenambea nene. Weramu wuje wansaora to, umba wandaendije wenanawamo wanave tugaive jewena.
Weramu weapamo Amisye po Anawayo Vambunine raugaje wasai muno wapo Amisye apa ayao tugae raen tenambe.
Weapamo wapantukambe ayao tugae rai ma jewena, yara wadaen to, muno wapo ayao tugae raenamo aruriate ma inta no rai ramu. Wemi mbewar syo ratoe ore wasai.

Vatano rui pirati pangkarive? Vatano po Yesus amamarave, opamo pangkarive pare Yesus opamo Mesias napi Amisye po atutir de be akarive wansai jewen. Vatano napije be marovave Kristus ai, po Injayo Amisye amamarave muno Apa Kavo tavon.
Weye are pirati po Arikainyo Amisy amamarave, weamo Injayo Amisye tuna autane jewen. Yara are pirati po raura pare, “Syanave Arikainyo Amisye ai,” opamo Injayo Amisye tuna autan.

Ayao wemirati wapo raraniv arono manasyin wapanave Yesus aijoe, ayaowe wato mi syare wapo raijar matuve. Wapare wapo raijar matuve, weamo wabe intabove tawan irati Arikainyo Amisye ai muno Injayo Amisy ai.
Somirati Apa ana po raurairive wansai: kovo noa nuge nuganui.
Syo nyovara waowe so ratoe ore wasai weye syare wapo raen vatane inta ware wo ananyao nsosobe raugaje wasai indamu wo wasaponae.

Amisye po Anawayo Vambunine raugaje wasai, weti vatane wo wasanyao jewen kai, weye Anawayo Vambunine taune mo wasanyao anakotare rai tenambe. Anawayo Vambunin ama ananyao Mo raugaje wasai mamo aruriate ma jewena, yara tugae ma. Maisyare omai ti, syare wabeta Ama ananyaowe rai indamu wabe intabove tawan irati Kristus ai.
Sya arikainyo inanuga no wasai, syare wano tawan no Kristus ai indamu arono pakare no mine vone so raijamo, wanjanive ramu, muno arono de Po wansaen, wansamane no Amune rai nora.
Yesus Kristus apa ana dave mamo mamai dave, omamo wandaen to. Weti umba syare wandaen tavon mamo are pirati apa ana dave mamai no Amisye amune rai opamo Apa arikainye waino ai pije.
